messages.text: What does 'walk-in visit' mean? I only need a general definition; do not arrange a call or suggest clinics.

A "walk-in visit" means you can go to a medical clinic or hospital without an appointment. You just show up during their working hours and wait for your turn to see a doctor or healthcare provider. It's often used for minor or urgent health issues that don't require scheduling in advance.
